rubric_name: Embedding and Auto Tagging Core Checks
description: Lightweight rubric for checking whether chunk records are structurally useful and whether topic tags are aligned with the chunk content.
quality_checks: Each chunk should include enough metadata to trace back to the document source.
The normalized text should be suitable for embedding and retrieval.
The markdown text should preserve useful structural cues for debugging.
Topic tags should come from the allowed taxonomy and should match the chunk semantics.
The embedding metadata should clearly record provider, model, and vector dimension.
acceptance_rule: Accept when the chunk record is DB-ready and topic tags are semantically grounded in the chunk.
warning_rule: Warn when tags are too generic, too many, or not aligned with the subject taxonomy.
